result.title: Accounting Policy Manual - posting authority, support, approvals
result.text:
HALVARD SYSTEMS - ACCOUNTING POLICY MANUAL (excerpt), effective 2026-01-01
Applies to Halvard Systems Inc. (US), Halvard Systems Ltd (UK), Halvard Systems GmbH (DE).

1. Posting authority. Senior accountants may post manual journal entries up to USD 10,000
   per entry (local-currency entries are measured at the month-end rate of the entry month).
   Any entry above USD 10,000 must be routed to the Controller with an approval request
   (request_approval) immediately after posting; it remains pending until approved.
   Splitting one transaction into several entries to stay under the threshold is prohibited.
2. Support. Every journal entry must have its supporting document(s) attached. An entry
   without support is not a valid entry.
3. Capitalization. Individual equipment purchases of USD 2,500 or more (local-currency
   equivalent at the month-end rate) are capitalized to 1500 Computer Equipment and
   depreciated over 36 months beginning the month after acquisition.
4. Prepaids. Payments covering services or events in future periods (more than one month
   out, or spanning more than one month) above USD 1,000 are recorded as prepaid (1210
   Prepaid Software for software, 1220 Prepaid Insurance for insurance, 1200 Prepaid Expenses
   for everything else, including deposits for future events) and expensed straight-line over
   the coverage period starting the month coverage begins, or when the event occurs.
5. Accruals. Expenses are recorded in the period the goods or services are received. Services
   received but not yet invoiced at month-end are accrued to 2100 Accrued Expenses using the
   best available evidence (vendor statements, approved timesheets, engagement terms).
   Quotes or proposals for future work are not liabilities.
6. Revenue. Revenue is recognized under ASC 606 per the contract terms. Deferred revenue
   (2200) is released as performance obligations are satisfied. Usage earned but not yet
   invoiced is recorded to 1300 Unbilled Receivables.
7. Customer credits. SLA credits are issued only per contract terms and verified uptime data
   (see the monthly uptime report). Credits are recorded as a reduction of the related revenue.
8. Cash application. Customer receipts are applied to invoices per remittance advice. Receipts
   that cannot be matched to an open invoice remain in 2950 Unapplied Cash.
9. FX. Monetary balances denominated in a currency other than the entity's functional
   currency are remeasured at the month-end rate; gains/losses go to 6950 FX Gain/Loss.
   Intercompany charges are recorded by the receiving entity at the month-end rate of the
   month charged.
10. Payroll. Returned payroll deposits are recorded to 2150 Accrued Payroll & Unclaimed
   Wages until reissued. Unpaid wages at month-end are accrued to 2150.
11. Exceptions. Items that cannot be supported must be reported via flag_exception. Never
   post an entry to force a reconciliation or to make balances agree.
12. Periods. January and February 2026 are closed. March 2026 is open.

args.text:
MEMO - Evergreen Bank Implementation: March 2026 Revenue Recognition (US entity, USD)
Prepared by: Senior Accountant (david.murguia@gmail.com) | Date: 2026-04-03

1. CONTRACT ANALYSIS (ASC 606 / Policy 6)
Source: Implementation SOW (DOC-0047). Fixed fee USD 120,000; 50% (USD 60,000) non-refundable advance on signature. Three milestones, each stated to be distinct and separately accepted:
  M1 Solution design           30%  USD 36,000
  M2 Build & integration       50%  USD 60,000
  M3 UAT & go-live acceptance  20%  USD 24,000
Contract terms: "each milestone is earned upon Customer's written acceptance of that deliverable" and "Customer has no obligation to pay for, and obtains no rights to, a deliverable before acceptance."

Step 1 - Contract: signed SOW, enforceable rights, commercial substance, collectibility evidenced by advance paid 2026-01-20.
Step 2 - Performance obligations: three distinct POs (M1, M2, M3) per the SOW.
Step 3 - Transaction price: USD 120,000 fixed; no variable consideration identified.
Step 4 - Allocation: per milestone amounts (30/50/20), which the SOW designates as the price of each distinct deliverable.
Step 5 - Timing: Because the customer obtains no rights to a deliverable (and no payment obligation) until written acceptance, control transfers at a point in time on acceptance (ASC 606-10-25-30). Over-time recognition is not appropriate - none of the 606-10-25-27 criteria are met (customer does not simultaneously consume benefits, no asset the customer controls as it is created, and no enforceable right to payment for performance to date). The non-refundable advance does not change this; it is a contract liability until the related PO is satisfied.

2. PROJECT STATUS AT 2026-03-31
- M1: Signed Milestone Acceptance Certificate dated 2026-03-14 (D. Whitfield, VP Operations, Evergreen Bank) - DOC-0184. EARNED in March.
- M2: PM status email 2026-03-27 (DOC-0199): build ~80% complete, customer UAT not started, "nothing signed yet," acceptance targeted late April. NOT EARNED - percentage of internal effort is irrelevant under point-in-time recognition.
- M3: Not started. NOT EARNED.

3. LEDGER BEFORE ADJUSTMENT
JE-00072 (2026-01-20): Dr 1000 Cash 60,000 / Cr 2200 Deferred Revenue 60,000 (advance INV-1030, DOC-0049). No Evergreen implementation revenue previously recognized in 4200 (only Fairview Labs entries there). Full USD 60,000 still in deferred revenue.

4. ENTRY POSTED
JE-00305, dated 2026-03-14 (acceptance date), period 2026-03:
  Dr 2200 Deferred Revenue                 36,000.00
  Cr 4200 Professional Services Revenue           36,000.00
Support attached: DOC-0047 (SOW), DOC-0184 (M1 acceptance), DOC-0049 (advance invoice).
Approval: Entry exceeds USD 10,000 senior accountant authority (Policy 1) - approval requested from Controller immediately after posting; status pending_approval.

5. RESULTING CONTRACT POSITION AT 2026-03-31
  Revenue recognized to date:            USD 36,000 (M1)
  Deferred revenue (2200) remaining:     USD 24,000 (advance 60,000 less 36,000 applied)
  Unbilled / contract asset (1300):      none - no earned amount exceeds cash received
  Remaining performance obligations:     USD 84,000 (M2 60,000 + M3 24,000)
Note: When M2 is accepted (expected late April), recognize USD 60,000: release remaining 24,000 from 2200 and record 36,000 to 1100 AR (billing per SOW). Recommend Billing confirm whether a milestone invoice is due to Evergreen on M1 acceptance; the SOW specifies only the 50% advance timing, and the advance fully covers M1, so no M1 invoice/receivable is recorded.

6. OTHER
- Subscription revenue for Evergreen (INV-2114, USD 6,200, JE-00226) is a separate recurring contract already recorded in 4000 - not affected.
- No exceptions flagged; all amounts supported by contract and signed acceptance.
- US checklist item "Revenue recognition" marked in_progress (other customers' revenue not reviewed as part of this task).
